rules.description: A TSF design report by a qualified engineer must exist
rules.remediation: Commission a TSF design report signed by a suitably qualified engineer covering stability, hydrology and closure.

rules.description: An Engineer of Record must be appointed for each TSF
rules.remediation: Formally appoint an Engineer of Record with documented responsibilities and site-visit cadence.

rules.description: An independent tailings review must be completed within the last 3 years
rules.remediation: Schedule an Independent Tailings Review Board assessment and close out its recommendations.

rules.description: A dam breach / emergency preparedness plan must be in place
rules.remediation: Develop and drill an Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan with downstream notification procedures.

rules.description: TSF freeboard must remain at or above the design minimum (m)
rules.remediation: Immediately reduce pond volume or raise the embankment; verify freeboard survey against design criteria.

rules.description: TSF instrumentation data must be reviewed at least quarterly
rules.remediation: Implement quarterly review of piezometer and deformation monitoring with trigger-action-response plans.
